The explanation of how KL divergences are computed over mini-batches of size 5 with unspecified feature dimensions is too vague to allow replication. Furthermore, the absence of error bars, standard deviations, or multi-seed statistics in a field known for high variance makes the reported single-point results statistically indistinguishable from noise.
